geometry_policy: No coordinates, polygons, footprints or parcel boundaries are created or inferred. Every selected row remains NOT_BOUND.

features.name: Lloyd's Building
features.official_source_evidence: Lloyd's is the primary occupier and market source for the named building at 1 Lime Street; authoritative building records consistently identify the structure as the home of the Lloyd's insurance market.
features.classification_finding: Office Building is strongly supported. Exact binding must be limited to the Lloyd's Building footprint and must not include neighbouring Lime Street or Leadenhall Street buildings.

features.name: DP World London Gateway Logistics Park
features.official_source_evidence: DP World identifies London Gateway and its Logistics Park as one trade ecosystem with a port-centric logistics park, flexible warehousing and logistics services.
features.classification_finding: Industrial and logistics use is authoritative, but the park is not one Industrial Unit. A named warehouse or exact industrial parcel is required before geometry binding.

features.name: Television Centre White City
features.official_source_evidence: The official Television Centre site presents homes, offices, dining, entertainment, studios, retail and workspaces across the White City destination.
features.classification_finding: Mixed-use character is authoritative, but Television Centre is a multi-building complex. A named building or defensible complex parcel is required before binding.

features.name: 100 Bishopsgate
features.official_source_evidence: The named building domain is the primary source target and authoritative building records identify a completed office-led City of London development.
features.classification_finding: Office use is strongly supported, but the development includes a main tower and an associated lower building. The exact named component or defensible development parcel must be selected.

features.name: Prologis Park Brooklands
features.official_source_evidence: Prologis is the authoritative logistics-property operator for the named Brooklands park; the current exact property path requires remote revalidation.
features.classification_finding: Industrial use is plausible, but park-level evidence cannot represent one Industrial Unit. A current official path and a named warehouse or exact parcel are required.

features.name: Blickling Hall
features.official_source_evidence: The National Trust is the authoritative property source for the historic house and Blickling Estate in Norfolk.
features.classification_finding: The principal hall identity is authoritative, but the visitor property includes gardens, parkland and estate functions. The hall must be isolated and Detached Home taxonomy reviewed.
